svg.title: Independent oscilloscope trace
svg.desc: Constructed zero-centred sine on a square grid. Peak height is 2.5 divisions, and two complete cycles occupy eight horizontal divisions. The centre horizontal line is the zero reference.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Task: read the calibrated sine trace

path.style: stroke: rgb(61%,18%,27%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 2.5; fill: none; fill-rule: evenodd;
